01

How much does a Design + Build marketing site cost?

[]

Design + Build projects start at $7K for a complete marketing site, typically 5–25 pages with a design system, CMS, animation and an SEO baseline. After a 30-minute scope call you get a fixed quote within one business day, and the price only changes if the scope does.

02

How long does it take to design and build a marketing site?

[]

Most Design + Build projects go live in 4–8 weeks, depending on page count and how quickly feedback comes back. The schedule is agreed with the quote, and work is shared as it progresses in Figma and on a staging link.

03

Should our marketing site be built on Webflow, Astro or Next.js?

[]

Webflow suits teams that want to edit and publish visually without a developer. Astro or Next.js fit sites that need custom integrations, heavier interactivity, or should live alongside the product codebase. The platform is recommended on the scope call, based on who edits the site and how it will grow.

04

Can our team update the site after launch?

[]

Yes, that's what the build is designed for. Pages are assembled from reusable components, so marketing can add a page or swap a section without breaking the layout. Blog posts, case studies and job listings run on the CMS, and the handoff covers how to edit and publish.

05

Can you work from our existing brand?

[]

Yes. Most projects start from an existing logo, colors and typography, and the style definition step turns them into a design system for the web. If the brand needs a refresh, that can be part of the scope.

06

What happens after launch?

[]

Every project includes 30 days of free fixes after launch. After that, new pages and features are quoted as small fixed-fee projects, or covered by an ongoing support retainer if you expect regular work.

07

Who designs and builds the site?

[]

Ira, the studio's principal and a design engineer, leads the project from the scope call to launch, with trusted specialists joining when a project needs extra design capacity.

01

How does ongoing website support work at Nation?

[]

A monthly retainer reserves dedicated studio time for your marketing site: new pages, landing pages, design updates, performance and accessibility work, and maintenance. The scope and monthly fee are agreed upfront, priorities are set together in Slack, and work ships through the month.

02

How much does an ongoing support retainer cost?

[]

Ongoing support starts from $3K per month. The fee depends on how much design and development you expect each month and is agreed upfront with the scope, so there are no surprise invoices.

03

Can you support a site Nation didn't build?

[]

Yes. Ongoing support works for sites built by another agency, a freelancer or an in-house team. The first week includes a review of the existing build, covering structure, components and performance, alongside the first tasks in the queue.

04

Which platforms do you support?

[]

Webflow, Astro and Next.js marketing sites. Webflow sites keep their visual editing for your team, and custom-coded Astro or Next.js sites are supported the same way.

05

Can our team still edit the site ourselves?

[]

Yes. Your team keeps full access to the CMS and can publish content as usual. The retainer covers the work that needs design or development: new layouts, components, integrations and fixes.

06

Can we pause or cancel the retainer?

[]

Yes. Retainers run month to month with no long-term contract, so you can pause during quieter periods or cancel before the next month starts.

07

Who works on our site?

[]

Ira, the studio's principal and a design engineer, leads every retainer and stays your main contact. When a task needs extra capacity, a trusted specialist joins, with Ira responsible for delivery and quality.

01

What do you need from us to start a production build?

[]

Final or near-final Figma files, or a working prototype, plus access to your platform. Missing breakpoints, states and interactions get flagged in the design review and resolved with your designer before the build starts.

02

How much does it cost to build a site from a Figma design?

[]

Production builds start at $4K and typically go live in 2–6 weeks. After a 30-minute scope call you get a fixed quote within one business day, covering the component system, CMS, performance pass and QA.

03

Can you turn an AI prototype into a finished site?

[]

Yes. Prototypes from Claude, v0, Lovable and similar tools usually look right but need work underneath: structure, responsiveness, accessibility, performance and editability. A paid audit comes first and shows what can be kept and what gets rebuilt, then the build is quoted as a fixed fee.

04

Which platform will the site be built on?

[]

Webflow, Astro or Next.js, chosen to suit the project. Webflow fits teams that want to edit visually, while Astro or Next.js fit sites with custom integrations or that live alongside the product codebase. If your design system has tokens and components, they carry straight into the build.

05

Do you build for design agencies?

[]

Yes. Nation works as a development partner for design and branding agencies, building from the agency's Figma files under their name or credited. That includes new builds, rebuilds and platform migrations.

06

Can you migrate our existing site to Webflow?

[]

Yes, including moves off WordPress, like the AlphaPoint marketing site. Content, URLs and redirects are planned before launch to protect existing search traffic.

07

What happens after launch?

[]

Every build includes 30 days of free fixes. After that, new pages and features are quoted as small fixed-fee projects, or covered by an ongoing support retainer.
